raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule (Civilian Firearms Export Controls)
raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring a more conventional export control framework for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts. For China-based exporters and traders of civilian firearms, optics, and components, this signals a shift in license requirements and classification under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Exporters should re-verify ECCN classification (e.g., 0A501/0A502 series), confirm whether a BIS license or license exception now applies, and re-screen all US-origin and re-export transactions. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment remain relevant for any US-bound shipments, and Entity List / restricted party screening is still mandatory. Note that firearms remain a highly sensitive category; state, local, and other federal restrictions (ATF, ITAR for defense articles) may still apply.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及相关零部件更为常规的出口管制框架。对于中国民用枪支、光学器件及零部件出口商和贸易商而言，这意味着《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可要求和分类可能发生变化。出口商应重新核实ECCN分类（如0A501/0A502系列），确认是否适用BIS许可或许可例外，并对所有美国原产及再出口交易重新筛查。对美出货仍需关注301关税及HTS归类一致性，实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制要求。需注意枪支属高度敏感品类，ATF及ITAR（国防物项）等其他联邦、州及地方限制仍可能适用。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts under the revised EAR (e.g., 0A501/0A502 series) and confirm whether a BIS license or license exception now applies after the rule rescission.
Confirm items are not USML defense articles under ITAR and identify any ATF import/export permit obligations that remain unaffected by the BIS rule change.
Run restricted party and Entity List screening on all US-origin and re-export transactions; retain end-user and end-use statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for firearms and parts against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Document the license determination (NLR, exception, or license) for each shipment and keep audit-ready records of the classification rationale.
Check ammunition and component lead content against applicable environmental and safety disclosure requirements for US-bound goods.
